scope: Selected frozen 75% ICC / 25% full-graph SAR versus ICC-only on the SAME existing 256 fresh evaluation populations. No fitting or reselection.
designation: All new Selected-versus-ICC analyses are exploratory and descriptive. Original Holm3 and Holm12 families remain unchanged.
units: Population is the Monte Carlo unit. Four contexts have equal weights; endpoints and eligible districts are averaged within each population. Paired Selected-minus-ICC differences preserve within-population dependence.
subgroups: mask all / finite observed endpoint / absent from common sampled district set
context by endpoint by mask and endpoint/mask balanced summaries
metrics: IS95: width + 40*(lower-truth) if truth<lower + 40*(truth-upper) if truth>upper
MSE and RMSE sqrt(mean district squared error), with sqrt(mean population MSE) distinguished from mean population RMSE
absolute distance of aggregate coverage from 0.95
absolute_and_relative: Absolute selected-minus-ICC differences and relative difference 100*(selected/ICC-1) where ICC !=0, signed-bias ratios omitted when denominator small or meaning ambiguous. RMSE ratios use same aggregation definition.
mcse: Within context s(population statistic)/sqrt(n). Across contexts sqrt(sum_h s_h^2/n_h)/H for fixed equal context weights H. Nonlinear sqrtmeanMSE, ratio, relative difference and aggregate distance95 use paired population delta influence values, centered within context. For zero or undefined denominators output null.
intervals: Descriptive 95% intervals estimate +/-1.96*MCSE; not simultaneous, no new p values or Holm changes, and not prevalence intervals. Coverage-distance non-differentiability at95 is explicitly flagged; report coverage intervals and interval-induced distance bounds too.
figure: English scientific static point and whisker figure of Selected-minus-ICC IS95 and RMSE across contexts and global; descriptive95MonteCarlo intervals.
development_audit: Recover all original 32 Laplace-development populations, candidate weight grid scores, best-versus-second margins and leave-one-population-out selections/margins without changing chosen weight. Prepare NUTS development replay inputs/commands only, and state approximation/integration mismatch clearly.
original_families_audit: Read original Holm3/Holm12 score scripts and stored outputs; identify population/province units, variance/MCSE formulas and reference distributions without changing results.
prohibited: No model fits / NUTS / optimization launched by this agent
No original source or results modified

public_copy_provenance.rule: Only machine-specific input-root path values replaced with PRIVATE_RUN_ROOT; original registration remains preserved privately and its digest is retained.
